info.name: Skill-Pulse API Tests
info.description:
Complete Postman test suite for Skill-Pulse.

## Setup
1. Import `Skill-Pulse-Local.postman_environment.json`
2. Start backend: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` from `backend/`
3. Run folder **00 - Setup & Smoke** (set verification_code from email/DB)
4. For role-specific tests, login as manager/recruiter and re-run those folders

## Variables
Set `repo_url`, `branch`, `analysis_run_id`, `repo_id` in environment after analysis.

## Notes
- Analysis runs are async: poll **Get Analysis Status** until status=completed
- Developer analysis needs GitHub connected + Python contributions
- Manager analysis needs registered team developers on the repo
